title: abutilon eximium
intro: Abutilon eximium, commonly known as the Orange Globe Mallow, is a flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon eximium are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antipyretic and anti-edematous properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
